mods.name: REIMAGINED Shader
mods.description: A shader mod that delivers realistic visuals, featuring dynamic lighting, vivid weather effects, real-time shadows, rippling water, and more. On top of that, Fog-Of-War, featured in MDZ 2, is also included in this mod. This will hide anything behind building, tree, wall inside buidling, etc....  Thereby enhancing the gaming experience, making your games more and more realistic.
mods.notes: Bundled with Graphic Optimizer. This will adjust your shader settings based on your chipset so you don't have to worry about heat and performance issues.
mods.author: Civert0
